svg.title: Reproduce the gates; inspect the evidence
svg.desc: The main command is executable as shown. It builds the actual DA adapter offline, runs the tests and executes both bindings. The optional chain build requires staged grpcio-tools; chain_demo requires pinned cryptography, pycryptodome and grpcio-tools extras, documented exactly in runbook.md. Initial native CLI/protoc/stack bring-up failures and the resolved local configuration are recorded in evidence.md rather than omitted. The demonstration uses generated non-sensitive data and fresh local keys under ignored artifacts; do not copy private data into it. For the presentation itself, build.py and requirements.txt in this directory generate the editable PowerPoint, vector PDF/SVG and speaker notes from one layout. No M2 implementation is required or created by these reproduction commands.
svg.text: Reproduce the gates; inspect the evidence
Run from the fusion-module-interfaces checkout; see runbook.md for prerequisites and exact commands.
Builds DeTTa adapter offline, runs 27 tests, executes both demo bindings.
Pinned extra tools + isolated local genesis; exact
Requires inspected sibling checkouts and cached Cargo dependencies. No production keys or private episodes.
